note: s_end: the day's last tape slot (the study opens no window in its last 300 slots). trades: [slot, tx index, event index, sig, user index (users[]), buy 0/1, sol, tok, vsol, vtok, fee bps, creator fee bps] in chain order (raw TradeEvent fields; 0 bps = absent). windows: the study's T2 windows of the chosen config (ps6 'T2|c' filter) with j = trigger trade index, st / en (window start / end on the block-position clock, float64 repr), hpct (float32 repr), and per queue row a / b / c: armed (ps5 per-token rule over all windows), fill (first hit of ps4: x = crossing trade, m = last trade ahead of us, a_land, ft = ps5 fill time, valid = ft < en, s_in, off = exit offset slots, pnl = gross SOL float32 for 0.55 SOL / c2_tp10_sl20, xt = our sell time), aend, slots (armed slots charged). ht3_below: htype-3 triggers below 5% of supply (must not arm).
